header.title: Suppl. Mag. 29: Old Testament; New Testament, Mattheus; spell (healing incantation) against fever; prayer to archangel Michael; Psalm 090,1-2; Pater Noster…: AI translation (Claude)
header.author: Supplementum Magicum
header.source: Translated by Claude (claude-opus-5-5, Anthropic) from the library's urn:magic:dclp:64605:grc, from papyri.info's Digital Corpus of Literary Papyri (CC BY 3.0), one English line for each line of the original. Only some passages are translated so far: those that the Atlas of Ancient Myth, Magic in the Ancient Texts and the demons-and-angels study cite.
header.statement: An AI-generated translation. No specialist has reviewed it.
header.availability: CC BY 4.0: credit papyri.info's Digital Corpus of Literary Papyri (the source's own licence is CC BY 3.0) and this AI translation.

notes.1: Lines 1–2 are too damaged to read (sark- may be 'flesh'); the end of line 9 is illegible. 'Of the earth' (γ̣ῆς, line 4) is a doubtful reading. The adjuration may address the fever or Michael. ἀππαλλάξ⟨ατε⟩ ('depart', plural) is completed by the editor; 'from Taiolle' renders a genitive, though the wearer is masculine in line 7. Lines 10–11 are Psalm 90(91):1.

nodes.text: Shivering fever, I adjure you, Michael, arch-
angel of the earth: daily or night-
time or quartan, by the Almighty
Sabaoth, no longer touch the soul of the
dy. I adjure you, and the dead too: depart
He who dwells in the help of the Most High, in the shelter
of the God of heaven shall abide. He will say
